text:
maria: AM async check-in — what I did: kicked off cross-region warmup in eu-west-1 (canary image v2026.03.14), ran 10 prewarm requests to model pool, captured startup latencies. Blocker: autoscaler seems to add ~1s extra cold-start due to probe timings. Today: open CR, request quota bump for A100s, coordinate warmup window (16:00 UTC).

sam: Can you paste the perf numbers? I can loop in our cloud rep for the quota bump. Also can take the oncall followup. :thumbsup:

maria: quick numbers: median cold-start 420ms -> now 1.4s on canary nodes; token throughput unchanged. Attached logs in the ticket I'll open.

jin: re: autoscaler — I think livenessProbe timing is the culprit. Suggest bumping periodSeconds and failureThreshold. Small patch seems to remove the extra delay. Example snippet:
```yaml
livenessProbe:
  httpGet:
    path: /healthz
    port: 8080
  periodSeconds: 10
  failureThreshold: 3
```
I'll draft the kube change in CR-4123.

maria: thanks jin — that matches my repro. I'll add the CR link once you create it.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary v2026.03.14 deployed to eu-west-1 at 2026-03-14T15:26:00Z (1789123560). Logs: https://internal-logs/redwood/canary/1789123560

lee: FYI I already filed a quota ticket (#78923) with GCP support and attached perf numbers + expected sustained instances. Estimated response SLA: EOD. I asked for A100 quota + 20% buffer. :eyes:

sam: great — I'll ping our cloud rep and attach an urgency note. Also, can we schedule a gentle drain of 4 canary nodes at 16:00 UTC for the new probe patch? Need to minimize traffic impact.

maria: yes schedule please. target window 16:00-16:30 UTC, will run warmup script afterwards. Warmup command:
```bash
./infra/tools/warmup --region eu-west-1 --model all --parallel 8 --requests 50
```

jin: will open CR-4123 with the probe change + rollout strategy (maxUnavailable: 1) and request a quick review.

sam: pinging @maria @lee oncall for the drain. Also adding calendar invite.

maria: blocker update — blocked on quota confirmation and a quick CR review. If quota not approved, we fallback to burst in us-west until eu response.

lee: added billing + product to the quota ticket so they can approve faster. Also noted cost delta for A100 vs V100 in ticket.

maria: thanks — small ask to reviewer: confirm rollout strategy and probe numbers in CR. Should be a tiny change.

jin: ack, will tag reviewers and request a fast-track review.

sam: oncall note — if warmup triggers increased error rates, abort and rollback canary image to v2026.03.12. ops-bot will post health alerts.

ops-bot: alerting configured: canary-health-checks -> #eng-infra (threshold: 5xx > 0.5% over 2m).

maria: TL;DR: drafted CR to fix probe + rollout, warmup script ready, need quota confirmation and one review. Will update thread when CR is in and when quota confirmed. Thanks! :pray:
